articulation.label: bathroom
articulation.alt: bathroom: /b/ → /æ/ → /θ/ → /r/ → /u/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/θ/: Tongue tip lightly at or between the teeth.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
